- **Output:** `/home/mara/cwe-bench/sibling2/out/screener/15919.json`. I re-checked each file:line I cite against the pinned code; I did not build or run anything.
- **Trust decision:** at the pinned commit, nothing checks whether a request to the MCP SSE listener comes from a trusted local client (`src/mcp/server.go:202-219`). The fix puts a Host allowlist, an Origin allowlist and an optional token check in front of it.
- **`pattern_fit`:** B. The published fix stays inside `src/mcp` plus one config field, so it has little Pattern A scope.
- **Strongest lever:** the main REST API listener (`src/api/server.go:49-66`) reaches the same process controls with no Host/Origin check, and its token is off by default. A solver can dismiss it as "a separate feature with its own token." A fix that only checks Origin also misses rebound requests that carry no Origin header.
- **Biggest red flag:** none of the defined flags apply. The real risk is that the REST API may not count as in the advisory's scope, since I only had the summary, not the full advisory text. Repo size was not measured.
